(1) an orphan NOT listed here surfaces as NEW in the digest — a finding; (2) an entry whose path is no longer an orphan (referenced, touched, or removed) is stale — drop it. The baseline only shrinks via fixes; growth is deliberate acknowledgement. Seeded 2026-10-23 with the first detector run (21 pre-standard legacy scripts).
